units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 2b:14">Ab. Zar. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>ועל דא תְּבַרְתְּהוֹן וכ׳</he> and the answer given them on this plea is: why would you not accept (the Law when it was offered you)?
<cite ref="Ketubot 56a:13">Keth. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>דילמא מירכס ת׳ וכ׳</he> the receipt on account may get lost, and he (the creditor) may produce the note and collect the whole amount.
